notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/5da1d2e1df01f859b632df1e708218b5285ac6c4.png[/img]

Dear Smashers,

After the update on Tuesday, August 1, an issue occurred where the number of Enchantment Stones in the Special Event Boxes sold at the Zeppetta’s Research Results was incorrectly applied to the same amount as the Super Event Boxes.

We fixed the issue immediately, and all Smashers who purchased Special Event Boxes before the issue was fixed(August 16, 19:49 KST) will receive the same amount of Special Event Boxes.
(Distribution Date: After 12:00 AM on 8/17 (Thursday) (KST))

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

However, the sole survivor of this organization, “A”, still roams the shadows, hoping to clear his name and avenge his lost colleagues.

notes.title: ❗ Announcement for Changing in Competitive Match Penalties (edited)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/44faa366fb18bcb7b8501bf20a7c976b1aa858e9.png[/img]

Dear, Smashers

The penalties for Competitive Matches have been changed.
Please note that they will be applied immediately after the update.

[b]ㅡ Penalties ㅡ[/b]
If you disconnect before the game starts, penalties will be applied.

- 1 or more disconnects: Excluded from matchmaking for 5 minutes
- 3 or more disconnects: Excluded from matchmaking for 10 minutes, -30 tier points
- 5 or more disconnects: Excluded from matchmaking for 30 minutes, -100 tier points
- 10 or more disconnects: Excluded from matchmaking for 60 minutes, -100 tier points

※ The criteria for the penalties mentioned above are based on the number of occurrences within 72 hours.

notes.title: ❄ Check out Parfait's Skins! ❄
notes.content:
[h3][b]❄1. Ruler of Winter[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/d4bd0fb410c4d4be5cbf8e847a7319cc53cb4d42.png[/img]
- After years of being isolated in the cold, the Winter Queen Parfait is now on a mission to retrieve her loved ones. Not even the Sage Council's request or Witch Queen's proposal could move her. But as soon as her beloved “Kai” and “Gerda” went missing, she rushed to Library World. Even in the pain due to her body melting away, Parfait continues to search for the children.


[h3][b]❄2. Absolute Cold[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/82737ac336ddb573ffbd9b07c932fe286d3465d1.png[/img]
- The Winter Queen who is now closer to becoming a legend. Her appearance has not changed, but she has regained the composure she possessed when she lived in the eternal winter. Wherever Parfait goes, everyone and everything stops and pays her tribute.

[h3][b]❄3. Noble Ice[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/0bbe25a9e02d7241ca85d9a0883f7fd32a23b435.png[/img]
- The ice girl who has accepted another potential story within her. The girl was born with magical abilities. She saw herself as unique, and everyone else as insignificant. Parfait encounters magical girls who mistake her for a villain after becoming someone that many students only fantasized about. She does, however, offer to volunteer as the villain if they want her to...!

[h3][b]❄4. Lonely Ice[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/f53b181d7bb36174224e3ef60f28c316b3a8ce64.png[/img]
- The ice girl who has accepted another potential story within her. The girl was born with magical abilities. Parfait lived as a normal student while taking care of a cute cat named Kai. She didn't make any friends because she didn't want her powers to hurt anyone else. However, she is caught by magical girls using her powers to save Kai, and her cold and frozen world begins to change...!

notes.title: [Notice] Upcoming patch note scheduled for this week
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39863198/2b3724bc518421fb5b7f454bc608eed4d4342933.jpg[/img]

Hey, there. It is SMASH LEGENDS!

We are here to share the information of the upcoming patch which is scheduled for this week.
Patch schedule will be informed once it is confirmed by maintenance announcement.

Please check below for more details.

====


⚡  Changes and improvements ⚡

■ Legends balance improvement

[i] Dev team Comments: The percentage mobility affects the game is higher than we expected in the early days. 

Therefore, we are trying to balance the legends that we think it is beyond than originally designed availability.


In particular, Red has been developed to take strategic advantage by approaching foes in stealth and giving instant damages. However, we figured that Red can take advantage in a battle regardless of situations. 
So, with this upcoming patch, we reduced the attack range as well as the number of times skills available.
The team will check how it works continuously.


- Red
: The additional damage of the ultimate is reduced by 150.
: Basic attack damage is reduced from 1,300 to 1,100.
: Skill cooldown increases by 2 seconds.
: The aerial attack range is reduced to in accordance with the effect range.

- Cindy
: Skill cooldown increases by 1 second.
: When using aerial skills, the attack judgment range is reduced.
: When skill cooldown is reset due to a foe hit by an aerial skill, the time it takes to use the next skill slightly increases.

- Kaiser
: When using aerial skills, the same amount of damage will be applied for both the first and the second attack.
(Total amount of damage stays the same. Previously, for the first attack, it gave more damages than the second one.)
: When the jump skill attack hits, stunned time for foes will be increased.
: The Range for Kaiser to get attacked has been reduced. 


⚡  Bug fixes ⚡

■ Legends

- Fixed an issue where Red’s basic attack damage was not applied properly when a foe was located close to the Red.
- Fixed an issue where Red’s aerial attack damage was not done properly as much as the attack effect range.
- When Red gets attacked right after she turned invisible, knock-back will now occur.
- Fixed an issue where attack damage was not applied in a row sometimes when Cindy does basic attack.
- Fixed an issue where Kaiser’s additional attack’s knock-back that gets available when using Ultimate and basic attack damage were not the same.
- Fixed an issue when using the Witch Queen’s skill, the attack was not applied as much as the effect range of the magical orb.


⚡  NEW Update ⚡

■ New packages available

After a patch when certain conditions are met, the below packages will be available to purchase.
: Celebration Package
: Appreciation Package

=====

The above contents are subject to change when unexpected issues occur.


Thank you! 💕
